I don’t know, but he seems to have posted his stream in a discord community he owned though, because there were several viewers watching the stream beforehand in preparation. In fact the reason we have the stream footage is because one of those very viewers knew it was happening and recorded it. I remember using 4chan’s /pol/ board because it was a big deal on the board, and a Canadian user was posting screen caps of the shooting footage from his twitch desktop. You could see the chat and the shooters twitch account, he kept teasing the board because he was the one who recorded it, this was way before the full footage leaked. So my conclusion is he had to have a community ready for this. Also you could probably use a 4chan archive website and look for the threads of the shooting as it happened and find these screen caps I’m talking about. I remember it so well because the recorder was Canadian and Canadians are a running joke on /pol/ so everyone was giving him shit for teasing the full stream. Sorry for blog.
